tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_vulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve details for a CVE or vulnerability ID from OSV, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, and NVD. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/vulnerability. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-check
tools.description: Check one package and version for vulnerabilities using OSV, enriched with CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/package/check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-batch-check
tools.description: Check multiple packages and versions for vulnerabilities using OSV batch query, enriched with CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/package/batch-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_risk-assess
tools.description: Produce a consolidated vulnerability risk assessment for multiple packages, combining OSV, CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/risk/assess. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_dependency-tree
tools.description: Return direct and transitive dependencies, dependency versions and available dependency metadata using Google deps.dev API. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/dependency-tree. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-project-health
tools.description: Return project activity indicators, repository associations, package metadata and available security information using Google deps.dev API. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/package/project-health. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_repository-scorecard
tools.description: Retrieve the official OpenSSF Scorecard result for a GitHub, GitLab or other supported repository. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/repository/scorecard. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_lockfile-audit
tools.description: Parse supported package lockfiles, identify dependencies and versions, then combine deps.dev and existing OSV/CISA/EPSS/NVD findings. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/cybersecurity-intelligence/lockfile/audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "cybersecurity-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cybersecurity-intelligence_vulnerability, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-batch-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_repository-scorecard · Public sink: cybersecurity-intelligence_vulnerability, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-batch-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_risk-assess, cybersecurity-intelligence_dependency-tree, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-project-health, cybersecurity-intelligence_repository-scorecard, cybersecurity-intelligence_lockfile-audit · Destructive: cybersecurity-intelligence_vulnerability, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-batch-check, cybersecurity-intelligence_risk-assess, cybersecurity-intelligence_dependency-tree, cybersecurity-intelligence_package-project-health, cybersecurity-intelligence_repository-scorecard, cybersecurity-intelligence_lockfile-audit.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
